reassessment_reason: Recheck whether the Enterprise portal or official services documentation establishes a recurring statewide business export; clarify that campaign-finance downloads are a different subject.

access.bulk: Reviewed business and online-services pages establish business search and filing services but no documented recurring statewide business-record export, delivery schema or price.
access.api: The Enterprise landing page returned HTTP 403 to the read-only web tool. This is an observation limit, not proof that an API or export cannot exist; undocumented endpoints were not probed.
access.search: Official pages route public business lookup and requests to Enterprise. The online-services Data Download wording belongs to campaign finance, not the business registry.

fields.summary: No current recurring business-export dictionary, stable Business ID contract, entity scope, address-role map or control totals were established by reviewed official public pages.

active_status_semantics: An eventual source status must remain administrative registration evidence and is not proof of current business operation; no current export status codebook was verified.
statewide_completeness: The reviewed public pages do not establish a complete machine-readable business population or active count. Existing national-source coverage remains separate.
address_zip: No export address-role contract was established. Future projection must distinguish mailing, principal and registered-agent addresses and preserve ZIP5 and ZIP4 separately.
automation_terms_fees: No supported business-export automation, request-rate contract or price was established. No queries, accounts, contacts, paid requests or terms acceptance occurred.
redistribution: The official IPRA information page supplies a records-request route; that alone does not establish recurring export availability or a product-specific retention and derivative-use contract.
temporal_refresh: No recurring snapshot cadence, correction/deletion semantics, source release identifier, checksums or replay contract was established.

citations.evidence: Official business-services page describes registry services and online portal access.
Business filing services are separate from the campaign-finance Data Download entry.
Landing-page retrieval returned HTTP 403; no business lookup or record endpoint was queried.
Official records-request information route; no request was submitted.

strongest_next_action: Retain HOLD and the existing export-discovery question: determine whether an existing recurring entity export exists, then obtain its schema, population, key/status/address definitions, refresh/checksum controls, price and permitted derived uses. Contact and any record-bearing request remain separately gated.
